tags:
 - name: Clients
 description: >-
 Clients: the named, reusable configurations that define
how MCPJam\n connects to and talks to your MCP servers. The original `/hosts` paths\n remain as deprecated, ID-only com
patibility aliases with their original\n DTOs and their original (tokenless) write contracts; every alias response\n car

ries `Deprecation: true`. New integrations should use `/clients`.
 - name: Environments
 description: >-
 Project envi
ronments: named, live-editable execution bundles (one host and\n an optional standalone server group) that eval suites and go

als run
 against. Reads require project membership; archiving requires project
 admin.
 - name: Server diagnostics
description: Connect-level health checks against a saved MCP server.\n - name: Primitives\n description: 'The server''s MC

P primitives: tools, prompts, and resources.'
 - name: Export
 description: Full-server snapshots for diffing and CI.
 - n

ame: Execution
 description: 'Run the server''s primitives: call tools, render prompts.'
 - name: Eval runs
 description

: >-
 Asynchronous eval suite runs: create with 202, poll status, iterations,
 and traces.
 - name: Conformance runs

description: >-
 Ingest MCP spec-conformance results from the SDK/CLI into project-owned
 history. Distinct from

Eval runs (authored LLM cases) and from directory
 readiness.
 - name: Server connections
 description: >-
 Con

nect an MCP server URL to a project, authorizing in a browser when the
 server requires it.
 - name: Server accounts
description: >-\n The accounts a saved server signs in with, addressed by id or by name.\n Tokens are write-only: an upl
oad takes them and no route returns one.\n - name: OAuth\n description: 'Bring-your-own OAuth: import externally obtained toke

ns for a server.'
 - name: Studies
 description: >-
 Publish a project environment as a **study** for people outside t
he\n project to talk to, read what they did, and control who can reach it.\n Several of these NARROW access and take eff

ect immediately.


 The pre-rename paths (`/projects/{projectId}/scenarios`,
 `/projects/{projectId}/scenarios/{scen
arioId}`,\n `/projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/scenario` and\n `/projects/{projectId}/user-testing/scen
arios/{scenarioId}/…`) keep\n working and are deliberately not documented here. They return their\n original bodies, whi
ch spell the owning id `scenarioId` and whose detail\n read carries no execution settings, and every response answers with\n
`Deprecation: true` and a `Link` header naming its successor. They are\n removed at general availability; a new integrat

ion should use the paths on
 this page.
 - name: Catalog
 description: >-
 Discover the resources the other rout

es operate on: your account,
 projects, servers, eval suites, and chat sessions.
